label: Pixel 6 smartphone
description: Google Pixel 6 — 6.4-inch Tensor phone, Wi-Fi 6E (region-dependent 6 GHz) and 5G sub-6/mmWave; USB-C 3.1 with Ethernet adapter support.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, HE160) — Google notes 6 GHz is disabled in Taiwan, Japan and Singapore, where the phone behaves as Wi-Fi 6 only. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz (n1/n2/n3/n5/n7/n8/n12/n14/n20/n25/n28/n30/n38/n40/n41/n48/n66/n71/n77/n78) plus mmWave on US carrier models. USB-C 3.1 Gen 1 supports USB-C Ethernet adapters (usb0).
